# ConferenceRank — Full Agent Documentation

ConferenceRank is a static, open dataset of academic venues for computer science and adjacent pure sciences. This file is the complete integration guide for AI agents.

## What the data answers

- Is venue X any good? (CORE rank A*/A/B/C, SJR quartile Q1–Q4, H-index)
- How hard is it to get in? (per-year acceptance rates, accepted/submitted counts, some venues back to the 1990s)
- When is the deadline? (paper_deadline + abstract_deadline, AoE-normalized, with CFP links)
- Where should this abstract go? (match by title/abstract text against venue categories, topics, ranks)
- Is this journal legitimate or predatory? (indexed in CORE/SJR with publisher, ISSN, citation history — or absent)

## MCP server (preferred integration)

Package: `conferencerank-mcp` (stdio transport). Zero config; datasets are downloaded once and cached at `~/.cache/conferencerank/` with manifest-based revalidation.

### Install snippets

Claude Code:
```
claude mcp add conferencerank -- npx -y conferencerank-mcp
```

Claude Desktop / opencode / generic MCP host config:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "conferencerank": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "conferencerank-mcp"] }
  }
}
```

### Tools

- `search_venues(query, type?, ranks?, categories?, limit?)` — text search over title/acronym/publisher/ISSN with optional tier + discipline filters. `type` = conference | journal | all.
- `get_venue(id)` — full record: rank history, acceptance stats, deadlines, SJR history, OpenAlex topics/institutions.
- `compare_venues(ids[])` — side-by-side ranks, latest acceptance rate, SJR, H-index, deadlines.
- `suggest_venues(abstract, type?, ambition?, topN?)` — TF-IDF + category-lexicon scoring (same algorithm as the site's /suggest page). `ambition` = stretch | target | safe | all. Returns ranked venues with match reasons.
- `upcoming_deadlines(windowDays?, ranks?, categories?, deadlineType?)` — deadlines within N days; `deadlineType` = paper | abstract filters to entries having that date.
- `acceptance_stats(id)` — full per-year acceptance history for one venue.

## Static JSON API (no-MCP fallback)

Base URL: `https://rabimba.github.io/ConferenceRank/api/`

Workflow:
1. GET `index.json` — check `generatedAt` against your cache.
2. GET the endpoints you need (see llms.txt for the list).
3. Cache aggressively; data refreshes weekly (Mondays ~05:00 UTC).

### Schemas

Conference record (conferences.json, conference/{id}.json):
```json
{
  "id": "711", "title": "...", "acronym": "SOSP",
  "rank": "A*", "for_codes": ["46"], "categories": ["Distributed Systems & Networks"],
  "rank_history": [{ "source": "ICORE2026", "rank": "A*", "for": "46", "for_name": "..." }],
  "stats": [{ "year": 2024, "accepted": 41, "submitted": 261, "rate": 15.7 }],
  "stats_source": "papercopilot",
  "deadlines": [{
    "cycle": null, "year": 2026,
    "abstract_deadline": "2026-04-01 23:59:59",
    "paper_deadline": "2026-04-08 23:59:00",
    "notification_date": null, "timezone": "AoE",
    "location": "...", "conference_dates": "...", "cfp_url": "https://...",
    "source": "ccf"
  }],
  "openalex": { "topics": [...], "institutions": [...], "works_per_year": {...} }
}
```

Journal index record (journals-index.json — slim):
```json
{ "id": "acm-computing-surveys", "title": "...", "acronym": "CSUR",
  "core_rank": "A*", "sjr_score": 7.183, "sjr_quartile": "Q1", "h_index": 217,
  "is_oa": false, "categories": ["General & Interdisciplinary CS"],
  "publisher": "ACM", "issn": ["0360-0300", "1557-7341"] }
```

Full journal record (inside journals/{letter}.json chunks) additionally has: `core_rank_history`, `sjr.history[]` (per-year sjr/quartile/h_index back to 1999), `country`, `dblp_url`, `openalex` (topics, institutions, works_per_year, two_year_mean_citedness).

Deadline record (deadlines.json): conference deadline entry flattened with `venue_id`, `acronym`, `title`, `rank`, `categories`.

## Interpretation guidance for agents

- When a user asks "is X a good venue", report BOTH systems when available: CORE tier and SJR quartile. They measure different things (peer-review prestige vs. citation impact).
- `abstract_deadline` earlier than `paper_deadline` means mandatory abstract registration; missing it usually disqualifies the submission. Surface it prominently.
- Acceptance rates below ~20% are highly selective; 20–32% moderate; above ~35% accessible. Use this when calibrating "stretch/target/safe" advice.
- A venue absent from both CORE and SJR with a spammy-sounding publisher is a predatory-venue red flag. Say so plainly.
- Always recommend verifying deadlines on the official CFP (`cfp_url`) — community sources can lag.
